subject.title: [Feature]: add VALUE.md as a first-class workspace context file

question: Should `VALUE.md` become a core first-class bootstrap/context file with default seeding and workspace-file priority semantics, or should value guidance stay in existing files or an opt-in configurable bootstrap-file API?
rationale: The capability gap is source-proven, but adding a new default prompt-semantics file changes the core workspace model and intersects with the repo's lean-core guidance unless maintainers intentionally accept that surface.

options.title: Prefer configurable context files
options.body: Resolve the broader arbitrary bootstrap-file API so users can opt into `VALUE.md` without adding a new hardcoded core semantic file.

options.title: Accept first-class VALUE.md
options.body: Sponsor a fresh focused PR that adds `VALUE.md` everywhere existing first-class bootstrap files are recognized and documents precedence clearly.

options.title: Keep existing files only
options.body: Decline the new surface and document that value orientation belongs in `SOUL.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `USER.md`, or `MEMORY.md` depending on lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Prefer configurable context files
recommendation.body: Resolve the broader arbitrary bootstrap-file API so users can opt into `VALUE.md` without adding a new hardcoded core semantic file.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the clearest product/design signal on the direct implementation PR and has recent workspace/bootstrap history.
